text: ポケモンを　つかまえて　しらべれば　じどうてきに　ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえて　しらべれば
structure.en: if you catch Pokémon and examine them

structure.jp: ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！
structure.en: the pages keep increasing, you see!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. しらべれば = 'if you examine them'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the change keeps going on from now. ふえて いく = 'keep increasing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ, here in old-man form んじゃ, gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'you see'. ふえて いくんじゃよ = 'they keep increasing, you see'.
